notes: Undo for more of your work. On the marking screen, Ctrl Z (Cmd Z on a Mac) now also takes back lighting, a video's turn, a page taken out, a file removed, the rescan flag, anchor papers and Arrange pages. A short note says what came back, and Shift Ctrl Z or Ctrl Y does it again.

Everywhere else, Ctrl Z takes back your last change to classes, units, assignments, rosters, gradebook scores, to-dos and settings, deletes included. Inside a text box it still undoes your typing first. In the Planner, Ctrl Z works in the slide editor, and deleting a lesson has Undo.
